summary.taskName: Design and execute QA test cases for Leave Request Submission

test_plan.objective: Verify leave request submission handles valid requests, validates overlapping dates, and correctly applies leave balance limits.

out_of_scope: Manager approval workflow (covered in separate task)

test_cases.title: Submit valid leave request
preconditions: User is logged in as employee
steps: Select future start and end dates
test_cases.expected_result: Success message is displayed, modal closes, and balance/history updates.

test_cases.title: Submit leave request exceeding balance
preconditions: User is logged in as employee
steps: Select leave type with low balance
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed regarding insufficient balance.

test_cases.title: Submit leave request with overlapping dates
preconditions: User is logged in as employee
User has an existing leave request
steps: Select same dates as existing request
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed regarding overlapping dates.

subtask_breakdown.subtaskName: Write positive and negative test cases for leave submission
Execute manual and automated API tests for boundary conditions
Verify UI error states for overlapping dates and insufficient balance
Document test execution results and log defects

checklist_status.itemName: Test cases cover all acceptance criteria for Story 596
No critical or high defects remain open
QA test report generated and shared with the team
